scripts.emulators: npm run build:functions && NODE_OPTIONS="--require $PWD/scripts/emulator-loopback-direct.cjs" firebase emulators:start --project demo-partey --only auth,firestore,database,functions
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && npm --prefix functions exec -- tsc -p functions/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --project prod --only firestore,database,functions,hosting
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build && firebase deploy --project prod --only hosting
scripts.deploy:channel: npm run build && firebase hosting:channel:deploy preview-partey --project prod --expires 30d
scripts.build:staging: node scripts/check-staging-env.mjs && tsc -b && vite build --mode staging
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build:staging && firebase deploy --project preview --only firestore,database,functions,hosting
scripts.deploy:preview:hosting: npm run build:staging && firebase deploy --project preview --only hosting
scripts.test:e2e: node tests/e2e/flow.mjs && node tests/e2e/gameplay.mjs && node tests/e2e/impostor.mjs && node tests/e2e/impostor-custom-word.mjs && node tests/e2e/drawing.mjs && node tests/e2e/host-limits.mjs && node tests/e2e/word-scramble.mjs && node tests/e2e/perfectly-hold.mjs && node tests/e2e/cup-shuffle.mjs && node tests/e2e/number-rush.mjs && node tests/e2e/the-author.mjs
